title: Corpus and promotion evaluation

subtasks.description: Obtain rights, retention/access rules and a sampling plan across accents, channels, intents and sensitive fields.
subtasks.progress_note: Rights-record template, sampling plan skeleton and split/leakage rules drafted in WP13/annotation-protocol.md; actual rights, retention rules and source inventory require the customer/legal owner (12 open decisions listed in the draft).

subtasks.description: Create annotation guidelines, normalized/verbatim text policy, speaker/overlap labels, scorecards and evidence labels.
subtasks.progress_note: Annotation guidelines draft v0.1 (verbatim/normalized policy, Persian normalization rules, speaker/role/overlap labels, scorecard evidence labels, double-annotation and adjudication, manifest schemas, evaluator specs) in WP13/annotation-protocol.md; pending domain-owner review and threshold freeze.

subtasks.description: Assemble at least 20 Persian hours with a frozen 5-hour test set and separate English/mixed-language coverage.
Double-annotate at least 20%, adjudicate disagreements and prevent speaker/customer/time leakage between splits.
Implement WER/CER, DER/JER, entity/intent, QA agreement, factual-support and retrieval evaluators.
Publish slice sample sizes, uncertainty, abstention, coverage, latency and cost with each candidate result.
Gate model/prompt promotion on the frozen release criteria and maintain a rollback manifest; collect production corrections separately.

dependency_note: Corpus rights/protocol starts immediately. Later quality promotion is iterative and gates model-dependent packages; do not block baseline corpus preparation on models that consume it.
